title: Frequency Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the frequency of the radiation emitted during the transition.

title: Wavelength Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the wavelength of the radiation emitted during the transition.

title: Ratio of Wavelengths
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide the correct ratio of the wavelengths for helium and hydrogen radiation.

title: Explanation of Difficulty
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain why observing this transition in the laboratory is challenging.

title: Energy Level Equation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the energy level equation for hydrogen atoms in their response.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the energy calculations.
